Details zum Jobangebot
Summary Statement
You share our believe that successful product development is all about understanding users? You value teams of dedicated individuals that share unmatched passion for what they do - so do we!
We are a software development group within Ottobock that creates apps for people that wear our intelligent hand and leg prostheses. For people with amputations, good apps can make life a lot easier. For us it’s an incredibly rewarding field of work.
Duties & Responsibilities
In our organization, you are our UX & UI Designer:
You deliver input to software developers like wire frames, flows, scribbles, mockups, and interactive prototypes for mobile and web apps (we use Figma)
Together with our global Art Director, you are responsible for “Marina UI”, our global Ottobock UX guidelines & UI Framework
You work with, and coordinate external designers (this includes extensive onboardings)
In your second role as User Researcher you work on creating and validating app concepts and business models in our pipeline, before our development team spends time on it:
You initiate user interaction opportunities for the whole team to ensure a deep level of customer understanding within every single team member
You host customer workshops, user shadowings, in-depth interviews, surveys, and behavioral analysis (again, tools are up to you, this is what we currently use)
You actively shape the culture of our organization towards user driven product development
Profile
You are the right one for the job because:
You have excellent know-how in User Experience und User Centered Design
You are either a highly motivated university graduate or an experienced UX & UI designer and you are good in Figma
You enjoy working in a self-organized team that offers loads of creative freedom but also the responsibility to manage your own deadlines, workload and productivity
You are passionate to generate simple solutions for complex challenges. (“Simplicity” is one of our core values)
Ideally, you are familiar with Agile Software Development, Scrum in particular, and bring your own view and experience into our team
You embrace the idea of hypothesis driven product validation and have no fear to use its methods. (Lean Startup)
You bring knowledge in business model design (business model canvas) and business case calculation … or the will to acquire it fast
Your English is fluent; a little German makes life easier but is completely optional
Excited to travel to meet customers and users (about 20% of your time)
Benefits
The unbelievably rewarding job of helping amputees to overcome their challenges
The real chance and the freedom to make a difference in a large organization
An international team that has real drive to improve on a professional as well as personal level
Startup spirit with the safety net of a global player
Attractive remuneration incl. vacation bonus and 30 days vacation
Flexible & family-friendly working time models (incl. option for mobile working and home office)
Corporate benefits, job ticke, health management offers as well as many more benefits that await you at Ottobock

Would you like to join the Ottobock team? Then apply now!
